Below is a quick‑look table of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday (or a Thursday with an observed holiday on Friday) so that the weekend is extended to three days.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Good Friday** | April 7 | Friday | **Yes** | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | No | Holiday on Monday only. |
| Canada Day | July 1 | Saturday | No | Falls on Saturday; no extra day. |
| Labour Day | September 4 | Monday | No | Holiday on Monday only. |
| Thanksgiving | October 9 | Monday | No | Holiday on Monday only. |
| Remembrance Day | November 11 | Saturday | No | Falls on Saturday; no extra day. |
| Christmas Day | December 25 | Monday | No | Holiday on Monday only. |
| Boxing Day | December 26 | Tuesday | No | Holiday on Tuesday only. |

**Summary**

- **Only Good Friday (April 7, 2023)** creates a long weekend in Canada for the entire year.  
- All other federal holidays either fall on a Monday (no extra day) or on a weekend day (no additional day off).

If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, etc.), let me know and I can add those details.
